pr_summary: Implement robust validation in Schools::UsageController#show to validate supply and period parameters. The fix adds validate_supply and validate_period methods that only accept predefined values (electricity/gas for supply, daily/weekly for period). Invalid parameters now return nil and trigger a redirect instead of raising exceptions. The controller no longer uses send with user-controlled values directly.
environment_management: bundler with Gemfile and Gemfile.lock. Uses rbenv/nvm for version management (.nvmrc specifies node 14).

patch_file_cues.controller_changes: Added validate_supply and validate_period methods, replaced direct params.require usage with validated values, added nil checks before send call
patch_file_cues.workflow_changes: Added brakeman security scan step to CI

test_file_cues.factory_trait_added: :with_fuel_configuration trait in schools_factory.rb for creating schools with electricity and gas configured

platform_constraint_evidence: No Windows-specific or macOS-specific dependencies detected
notes: This is a Ruby on Rails 6.1 application using PostgreSQL. The fix addresses security concerns by validating user input parameters before using them. The test suite uses RSpec with FactoryBot. The CI runs on GitHub Actions (ubuntu-latest) and Travis CI (bionic). The project uses bundler for Ruby dependencies and yarn for JavaScript. No platform-specific restrictions that would prevent running on Linux x86-64.
